title: Senior UX Designer
descriptionHtml:
About Us

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. We’re on a quest to empower live communities, so if this sounds good to you, see what we’re up to on LinkedIn and X,  and discover the projects we’re solving on our Blog. Be sure to explore our Interviewing Guide to learn how to ace our interview process.

About the Team

The Twitch UX Community team is responsible for streamer creation and viewer engagement experiences across our product ecosystem, building and maintaining a cross-platform live streaming service that supports the growth and development of streamer based communities. A Senior UX Designer  on the Community Team is expected to lead design work at the program level, work with senior XFN partners, represent work to executive leadership, guide and mentor junior designers and will report directly to the Community Director of Design. 

About the Role

Designers at Twitch are involved in development from project conception all the way through execution and iteration. You will have the opportunity to do hands-on research and collaborate closely with engineers. If you are a champion for designing for humans and create playful and caring software for your customers, you will flourish on this team.

You can work from Twitch’s headquarters in San Francisco, CA; or from one of our hub locations in Seattle, WA; Irvine, CA; or New York City, NY.

You Will:

  • Collaborate with a cross functional development team of product managers, engineers, and designers
  • Learn from streamers and viewers about the ways they use our services and their desires to accomplish more
  • Think creatively about how to solve problems that will sustain streamers’ communities
  • Give back to the design community at Twitch by using and improving existing patterns and approaches
  • Combine qualitative and quantitative information to develop hypotheses about customer motivations and use that to improve your designs
  • Present your work to others by participating in design reviews and feedback sessions
  • Mentor and grow junior designers and help instill best practices with our team

You Have:

  • 5+ years of practical experience in UX design with an emphasis on content discovery and/or content engagement experiences. 
  • Demonstrated interaction design and visual craft skills including experience with prototyping mobile experiences
  • Demonstrated skills collaborating closely with other designers, researchers, product managers and engineers
  • Demonstrated ability to impact product strategy and roadmaps
  • An aesthetic sense and the ability to make confident decisions
  • Demonstrated empathy for the people using your software or products
  • Expertise with Figma

Bonus Points

  • Experience with AI workflows
  • Experience as a content creator or with UGC platforms
  • Experience executing complex research plans and talking to real customers
  • In-depth knowledge of design systems
  • B.S. (or M.S./MFA)  in Design, Interaction/UX Design or HCI

Perks

  • Medical, Dental, Vision & Disability Insurance
  • 401(k)
  • Maternity & Parental Leave
  • Flexible PTO

About the Role

Twitch is looking for a passionate, high energy addition to our Trust & Safety team. Our Trust & Safety Analysts are at the core of enabling Twitch to be a welcoming and safe place for people to build communities. This role will particularly focus on supporting the vibrant and fantastic communities on Twitch by keeping them safe from online harms. Alongside other Analysts around the world, you’ll be an essential element of Trust and Safety’s efforts to foster a thriving, creative Twitch.

We look for effective written and verbal communication skills, professionalism, initiative, and sound decision-making in all Trust & Safety candidates.

You can work in Sydney, Australia.     

You Will:

  • Assess and take appropriate action on user reports of Twitch policy violations promptly and effectively
  • Prioritize swift action on sensitive community issues, including child safety, terrorism and violent extremism, and off service behaviors
  • Review and assess sensitive content, including graphic, violent, or disturbing imagery and video as part of investigations, enforcement actions, and third-party engagements, with access to wellness resources and support
  • Review and respond to internal and external escalations
  • Participate in shift rotation for some weekends and holidays
  • Maintain expert understanding of Twitch’s policies, site features, and internal documentation
  • Contribute your insight and skills to the Trust & Safety team to support Twitch’s global community
  • Actively identify areas for improvement, using a data-driven approach to understand and mitigate risk
  • Leverage AI tooling and programmes such as SQL to build efficiencies and streamline workflows
  • Lead projects and broader organizational efforts to improve our operating model, conduct more effective investigations, and understand the evolving risk landscape

You Have:

  • 4+ years experience in Trust & Safety, Risk Operations, Investigations, Fraud Prevention, Content Moderation, Escalations and Crisis Management, or a related field
  • Experience investigating complex user, content, or platform safety issues and making risk-based decisions in ambiguous situations
  • Ability to engage with sensitive or graphic content in a professional capacity, with a commitment to personal wellness and use of available support resources
  • Familiarity with SQL, data analysis tools, or AI-assisted workflows used to identify trends, investigate risk, and improve operational efficiency
  • Ability to analyze large datasets, identify patterns, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Curiosity and willingness to learn new tools and technologies that support proactive risk detection and investigations
  • Experience working with cross functional partners, including Policy, Legal, and Engineering teams

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with Twitch as a creator
  • Previous employment at a games industry or live streaming platform company

Perks

  • Corporate Health Insurance & Life Insurance or Private Medical Insurance
  • Dental, Vision & Life Insurance
  • Superannuation or Pension Plan
  • Maternity & Parental Leave
  • Paid Time Off & Holidays
  • Commuter Benefits (only for the on-site employees)
  • Amazon Employee Discount

In this role, you will define and execute the strategy for helping streamers build deeper connections with their communities through interactive features and engaging monetization tools. You'll build solutions for products that help creators monetize (like Bits, Subscriptions, etc) while exploring new ways to help creators earn, engage their audiences, and grow their channels. About the Role

Come create the future of live streaming at Twitch!  As a member of Twitch's Business Development team, you'll use your industry and product acumen, existing network, and partnership knowledge to support new product initiatives and develop new opportunities with strategic B2B partners that benefit Twitch communities.

To support our growth, we are looking for an accomplished, motivated, and data-driven Senior Manager of Business Development who is a detail-oriented problem solver, thrives in ambiguity, and delivers results with limited oversight. The ideal candidate will have experience with relationship building, financial analysis/modeling, designing creative deal structures, and closing complex partnerships by working with cross-functional partners including product, legal, marketing, partnerships, and sales. You will report to the Director of Business Development and manage new and existing Twitch partnerships, which may include opportunities with other major tech companies, consumer services and products, payments, distribution partners, and more.

You can work in San Francisco, CA and New York, NY.

You Will:

  • Both independently and collaboratively identify, source, and close a variety of high impact partnership agreements with a diverse variety of companies. This includes developing strategy within a sector by applying relevant data points to make informed decisions and bring senior leadership on board from initial negotiations through execution to ensure successful long-term partnerships.
  • Lead multiple engagements simultaneously across business categories (net-new and existing) from sourcing to go-to-market. This includes driving financial modeling, legal reviews, co-marketing discussions, and appropriate internal reporting including P&L management.
  • Explore new business categories and growth opportunities, supported by a business case with sizing and financial projections, reasons to believe, success measures, risk mitigation, and recommendations.
  • Build external partner relationships quickly, including working backwards from both companies' goals with an understanding of needs, visions, and strategy on both sides.
  • Articulate product vision and strategies to both internal and external partners, and advise Twitch business units by contextualizing relevant insights based on customer feedback, market insights, and data analysis.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of experience in business development, B2B partnerships, product and platform partnerships, and/or partnership GTM management.
  • Experience partnering with legal teams to negotiate and contract agreements.
  • An understanding of Twitch's products and its business model.
  • The ability to develop recommendations in highly ambiguous environments.
  • Experience and comfortability working with technical product teams.

Bonus Points

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including engineering, science, policy, operations, and business stakeholders, to define and execute a product roadmap.

The Sr. Global Creator Programs Manager owns the end-to-end execution of Twitch's global scaled creator activation program, a structured system that recruits, develops, and retains creators through community-driven programming and milestone-based progression. About the Role

Twitch's Enterprise Platform & Technology (EPT) organization is looking for a Software Development Engineer II to build agentic AI systems on AWS that power Finance and enterprise functions across Twitch and Amazon. This is a hands-on engineering role where you'll design and ship MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers, Bedrock-based agents, and Claude-powered workflows, and own the AWS-native infrastructure behind them end-to-end (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, ECS/Fargate, CDK).

You'll work at the intersection of modern AI tooling and production cloud engineering, connecting AI agents to enterprise systems and data, automating manual operational work, and turning emerging AI capabilities into reliable, secure, observable services. The business problems are well understood; how you solve them with AWS + AI is up to you. We're looking for an engineer who stays current with the AI tooling landscape (models, agent frameworks, coding assistants, MCP), uses these tools heavily every day, and raises the bar on automation for the whole team.

You Will

Build agentic AI systems

  • Build MCP servers that give AI agents and assistants (Claude, Amazon Q, Kiro, and internal tools) secure access to enterprise data and actions, including through Bedrock AgentCore Gateway
  • Build Bedrock agents and Claude-powered workflows (using AgentCore, Knowledge Bases, Guardrails, Strands Agents, or LangGraph) that automate Finance work like reconciliations, reporting, variance analysis, and payouts
  • Evaluate and adopt new AI tools, models, and patterns as they emerge; turn prototypes into production-grade services
  • Design for safety and trust through prompt/tool design, guardrails, human-in-the-loop approvals, evaluation, and auditability

Build on AWS

  • Build and run the AWS services that host the agents and integrations (Lambda, Step Functions, API Gateway, S3, DynamoDB, EventBridge, SQS/SNS, ECS/Fargate)
  • Manage infrastructure with CDK, including CI/CD, IAM, VPC connectivity, secrets management, and beta/gamma/prod environments
  • Develop data pipelines between enterprise apps, Redshift, and S3, and make that data available to AI agents
  • Set up monitoring for agents and services (CloudWatch metrics, logs, alarms, tracing)

Cross-cutting

  • Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, and Tax stakeholders to translate business requirements into AI-driven solutions
  • Own production systems end-to-end, from deployment and monitoring to incident response and iterative improvement
  • Raise the team's bar through code reviews, docs, mentoring, and promoting AI-assisted development

You Have

AI and Agents

  • Demonstrated heavy use of AI tools (Claude, Claude Code, Kiro, Amazon Q Developer, or similar) integrated into your daily engineering workflow for code generation, data analysis, automation, and problem-solving
  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic API, or similar), including prompt design, tool calling, and structured outputs
  • Working knowledge of the current AI tooling landscape, including MCP, agent frameworks, RAG patterns, and model selection trade-offs

AWS and Engineering

  • 4+ years of professional software development experience
  • Hands-on experience deploying and operating production workloads on AWS (Lambda, S3, Step Functions, DynamoDB, IAM, API Gateway, or similar)
  • Proficiency in Python or TypeScript/JavaScript with a track record of shipping production code
  • Experience writing, deploying, and reviewing infrastructure-as-code (CDK, Terraform, or CloudFormation) in a team setting
  • Experience designing, testing, and debugging APIs (REST, JSON, OpenAPI) using tools like Bruno or Postman, including building request collections, handling authentication flows, and validating response contracts
  • Understanding of OAuth 2.0 authorization flows (authorization code, client credentials) and OpenID Connect (OIDC) for securing APIs and agent-to-service access

Bonus Points

  • Experience shipping MCP servers, Bedrock agents, or other agentic systems to production, using tools like AgentCore, Strands Agents, or LangGraph
  • Experience with LLM evaluation, observability, and guardrails (hallucination checks, cost/latency optimization, prompt versioning)
  • Experience with RAG and vector stores (Bedrock Knowledge Bases, OpenSearch Serverless, pgvector, or S3 Vectors)
